cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3 and Coco-Glucoside #4, refatting Glyceryl Oleate #7, no second anionic/reset route, no reset intent. Chelator Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate #13 is a minor late route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful cationic system (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9) plus refatter Glyceryl Oleate #7 and humectants Panthenol #12, Glycerin #14; no silicone.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one light polymer (#9) and a light refatter (#7); no persistent system.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: problem-led product with recognized dandruff active (Piroctone Olamine #6) and anti-dandruff positioning ('Anti Schuppen' in name) (7.2).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Fragrance and colorants are tolerability counter-signals.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: recognized active #6 -> scalp_active compatible. Unblind: name 'Anti Schuppen' -> scalp_active.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the itchy-scalp role is part of scalp_active (never repeat primary, §8; Appendix A Vichy row logic).

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: supported anti-dandruff formula with problem-led positioning ('bekämpft ... die Ursache von Schuppen', 'bei regelmäßiger Anwendung') (§9).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit itchy/tight scalp positioning ('Bei Schuppen und juckender Kopfhaut', 'juckende Kopfhaut wird beruhigt', 'Spannungsgefühl reduziert', 'sanft zur Kopfhaut') with supportive architecture: moderate buffered cleansing, Glyceryl Oleate #7, Panthenol #12, Glycerin #14, Malva #16. Counter: fragrance #19 and colorants.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Fragrance and dyes; not a veto.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C moderate: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable; scalp-concern targets so T6 applies but nothing is not_suited. T4: W has no neighbor; C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable -> no flags.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: 'Anti Schuppen' in name (E1 high) + dandruffSupport supported -> pass. S-SENSITIVE: E2 'juckende Kopfhaut ... beruhigt' on manufacturer page (E1 moderate) + scalpComfortTarget targeted + prominent comfort route Panthenol #12 (before Parfum #19) + cleansing not strong -> pass. S-DRY: E2 'spannende Kopfhaut'/'Spannungsgefühl' (manufacturer, moderate) + targeted + prominent humectant Glycerin #14 / Panthenol #12 / Glyceryl Oleate #7 -> also passes. S-PRIMARY: dandruff (named in product name). S-SECONDARY: only one secondary; highest precedence of the remaining = sensitive; dry is a third qualifying target -> review_extra_scalp_target. S-FOCUS: scalp_active primary -> no mismatch.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular. Equals schuppen's expected regular; differs from irritationen's expected gentle (I2: truthful amber for sensitive rows). I3: no cleansing neighbor -> no flag.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: E2 dry lexicon lists 'Spannungsgefühl der Kopfhaut'; the product says 'juckenden, spannenden Kopfhaut' and 'Spannungsgefühl reduziert' as part of a dandruff/itch claim. Treated as a qualifying dry claim, which makes three targets pass and raises review_extra_scalp_target; the standard does not say whether a tension claim embedded in an itch/dandruff claim is a distinct dry-scalp claim.
S-SECONDARY 'highest-precedence secondary' between sensitive and dry: used the S-PRIMARY order (sensitive before dry).
Malva Sylvestris (#16) is not in the E4 comfort list; not needed because Panthenol #12 is prominent.
13.8 scalp target confidence for sensitive: positioning moderate (manufacturer page only) caps it at moderate.
